title: How does one follow sports in 2025?
text:
I read this interesting piece in the New York Times recently about the cost of paying for all the streaming platforms necessary to follow sports in the year 2025.
This article really resonated with me, as I find it more and more difficult to pay attention to the teams that I’ve followed my whole life. I end up wondering how it will be possible for our son to develop into a fan of any of these teams when we can barely find any sports to play in the house. I’d love to see more Cubs games, but we don’t have cable anymore, and it seems like an impossible task to figure out where each game is streaming. In the end, I usually just check box scores on my phone and see random highlights on Facebook. This is not a recipe for long-term or generational devotion to a team.

title: Notes to Self for blog posting
text:
How to make a blog post
These are note for future me to be able to post to this blog, in case I forget what I am doing.

Start from the Terminal in /Users/amorriso/Documents/GitHub/quartoblog/posts
Run jupyterlab: python3 -m jupyter lab
Make a new directory for the new post. Change to that directory.
Make a new notebook in the empty directory.
The first cell must be in “Raw” format. Put the metadata there.
Write the post in the jupyter notebook. Along the way you can preview the post by launching preview from a Terminal within jupyter lab: quarto preview notebook.ipynb
Once the preview looks right when finished writing the post, go to Github Desktop. Commit the changes and then push to origin. (You should be in the gh-pages branch, but generally you won’t need to know that.)
Wait 30-90 seconds for the page to be live on Quartoblog.
